physical_spec_and_typography.font_family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

layout_description: Use a top horizontal sequence of three large cards with rightward arrows. From value estimation, a clean distribution line branches downward into three equal representation cards across the middle row. Their three downward connectors merge into a wide output card near the bottom center. A small dashed-border ablation card sits below or beside the output, connected by a dashed diagnostic line only. Make the three representation forms equally prominent: they are alternative granularities, not a serial processing sequence. A tiny neutral line divider under each card title provides the visual hierarchy. Do not add metrics, curves, labels about training results, or future observations.

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 9-10pt.
Adhere to stroke hierarchy: containers 1.5pt, dividers 1.0pt, arrows 1.5pt.
NO icons, NO pictograms, NO emojis, NO 3D rendering.
Feedback loop arrows are DASHED. Main forward flow arrows are SOLID.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no decorative shadows.
source_excerpt: 这一分路线输出紧凑状态、关联证据索引和保真风险。验证比较相同摘要长度下的关键约束遗漏率、动作前提满足情况与任务终态，并以去掉依赖关系、去掉未完成目标、随机保留等消融排除单纯长度优势。其输出直接作为下一分路线的恢复请求依据；不能由恢复模块看到压缩模块未被允许使用的未来答案。
